children: Singh moves into the CFO role after more than 11 years at Haier Appliances India, with experience across taxation and transfer pricing
Amia Singh has joined Jayson Industries as Chief Financial Officer, moving into the role in September 2026 after more than 11 years with Haier Appliances India.

Based in Delhi, Singh brings over 15 years of experience across finance, corporate taxation, international taxation and transfer pricing. Her career includes senior finance experience in the manufacturing sector, along with earlier stints at Apollo Tyres and Ernst & Young.
Singh spent more than 11 years at Haier Appliances India, joining the company in March 2015 and serving as Deputy General Manager until September 2026.

During her tenure, she worked across finance and taxation functions within the appliances business. Her experience included corporate taxation and financial matters associated with the company’s operations.
Her move to Jayson Industries marks a transition from the Deputy General Manager position at Haier into a CFO-level finance leadership role.
Before joining Haier, Singh worked at Apollo Tyres as an Associate Manager from March 2013 to March 2015.
Her responsibilities included corporate taxation, international taxation and transfer pricing, giving her experience in cross-border tax matters and related financial structures.

Singh began her professional career in tax consulting at Ernst & Young, where she worked from August 2011 to June 2012. Her role covered transfer pricing, international taxation and corporate taxation.
Singh’s professional experience has largely been built across manufacturing businesses, with her longest tenure at Haier Appliances India.
Her career progression has covered tax and finance responsibilities across consumer appliances and automotive manufacturing, before moving into the CFO role at Jayson Industries.
The appointment expands her remit from specialised finance and taxation responsibilities to a broader leadership position covering the company’s financial function.
At Jayson Industries, Singh will take responsibility as Chief Financial Officer, marking a new phase in a career that has combined corporate finance and taxation experience.
The appointment also brings more than a decade of experience at Haier Appliances India into the company’s finance leadership, alongside earlier experience at Apollo Tyres and Ernst & Young.
Singh is based in Delhi and has taken up the CFO position in September 2026.
